 Heat Unveil GTA VI-Inspired Jerseys, Travis Scott Collaboration in New Photos for 'Vice City' Night
 Mike Chiari Nov 6, 2026 The Miami Heat showed off the jerseys they'll be wearing for their "A Night in Vice City" game against the Milwaukee Bucks on Nov. 18.
 Last month, the Heat announced the promotional tie-in with the release of the Grand Theft Auto VI video game, which is set for Nov. 19.

 Bleacher Report 2d The Vice City uniforms have a similar look to the "Vice" alternate jerseys they have worn in the past, but several details set these ones apart, including the collaboration with rapper Travis Scott's Cactus Jack brand.
 As part of the jersey reveal Friday, the Heat announced that the on-court and Swingman versions of the "A Night in Vice City" jerseys will be available to fans in limited numbers on Nov. 18.
